subject.title: feat(diagnostics-otel): identify each instance with service.instance.id

question: Should diagnostics-otel accept a new `OTEL_SERVICE_INSTANCE_ID` plus hostname default, or should `service.instance.id` wait for the canonical OpenClaw resource-identity contract in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/93071?
rationale: The correct instance identifier affects operator-visible telemetry grouping, privacy, env/config surface, and the protected maintainer-labeled canonical issue, so automation should not choose the product contract.

options.title: Align With Canonical Identity
options.body: Require this PR to remove the custom env/hostname default and implement the standard or canonical identity seam with docs and exported-resource proof.

options.title: Adopt The New Env Contract
options.body: Accept `OTEL_SERVICE_INSTANCE_ID` as an OpenClaw-supported input, but require explicit docs, precedence, privacy, and upgrade proof before merge.

options.title: Pause For The Canonical Issue
options.body: Keep this PR paused while https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/93071 settles the stable instance identity source.

recommendation.title: Align With Canonical Identity
recommendation.body: Require this PR to remove the custom env/hostname default and implement the standard or canonical identity seam with docs and exported-resource proof.

likelyOwner.reason: `vincentkoc` has the strongest recent diagnostics-otel migration and current-resource-block history among the routing candidates.
